Akali.watch: Dodge the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it hits and marks you, the second dash follows even if you flee. You cannot dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, so save Ahri E Charm or Ahri R Spirit Rush to answer her engage.
Akali.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Build magic resistance and health against Akali's damage. Since Akali tends to have high magic resistance, build some magic penetration and use the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return.
Akali.fight: When Akali is inside Akali W Twilight Shroud, aim Ahri Q Orb of Deception at the moments she briefly appears. Once Akali R Perfect Execution is down, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm.
Akali.laning: Graze the backline minions with Ahri Q Orb of Deception to poke and clear the wave together. Minions block Ahri E Charm, so move to the side for an angle and save it unless you have a kill opportunity or are setting up a gank. Heal through minion kills with Ahri P Essence Theft. If mana is low, stop poking and farm.
Akali.combo: Use Ahri E Charm → Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Landing Ahri E Charm first makes Ahri W Fox-Fire prioritize the charmed Akali. If minions block Charm, cross the wave with Ahri R Spirit Rush to find an angle before starting. After throwing the orb, move toward Akali to land its returning hit too.
Akali.escape: Dodge the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip, and look to engage when Akali R Perfect Execution is down. If only Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip is down, she still has another way to move, so do not rush. When you go in, save at least one dash of Ahri R Spirit Rush to get out.
Akali.phase: Learning Ahri R Spirit Rush gives you your first strong window, but do not overextend in lane while it is down. In mid game, as you build ability power, look to catch one target with Ahri E Charm. In late teamfights, find an angle from the outside instead of engaging head-on.
Akali.teamfight: Use Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside their range, then pull one target toward your team with Ahri E Charm. If Akali hides in Akali W Twilight Shroud, aim the orb at the moments she briefly appears. Once the fight settles, chase stragglers with the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire and Ahri R Spirit Rush, while counting how many dashes you need to get out.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits a minion, so do not rely on standing behind the wave to dodge it. Avoid both its outgoing and returning paths, and watch how Akshan's sideways movement changes the return path. If you are low on health when Akshan R Comeuppance starts targeting you, do not run alone into the open; get behind terrain.
Akshan.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game. Akshan's main damage is physical and Ahri has relatively low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps.
Akshan.fight: Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is used is your chance to close the gap. Keep at least one dash from Ahri R Spirit Rush to get out.
Akshan.laning: Poke Akshan with Ahri Q Orb of Deception while also hitting the backline minions to farm. Minions block Ahri E Charm, so if Akshan is behind them, move to the side for an angle. Save Charm unless you have a kill opportunity or are setting up a gank. If mana is low, stop poking and last-hit to keep healing with Ahri P Essence Theft.
Akshan.combo: When Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, cross the minion wave with Ahri R Spirit Rush to find an angle for Ahri E Charm. After landing Ahri E Charm, use Ahri W Fox-Fire, then Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Akshan and move forward to land the returning orb too.
Akshan.escape: Engage with Ahri R Spirit Rush right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is used. If you land Ahri E Charm then, Akshan will struggle to escape.
Akshan.phase: In mid game, as you build ability power, actively look for angles to land Ahri E Charm.
Akshan.teamfight: Instead of diving in first, poke from the outside with Ahri Q Orb of Deception, then use Ahri E Charm to pull one enemy toward your team. If you are marked as a Scoundrel for killing one of Akshan's allies, do not face Akshan alone or stay within his finishing range. Once the fight is winding down, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire, while keeping track of how many dashes you need to get out.

Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup from Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and walk out of its area. Try to dodge the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam; if you are too close to dodge it, move toward her body to avoid the blade's outer edge. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to dodge the next hit immediately instead of waiting for the slow to end. Crowd control cannot interrupt Ambessa R Public Execution, so do not stand in a straight line with your team's backline.
Ambessa.build: Early, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. Ambessa deals mostly physical damage, and Ahri has low armor, so build armor first. If Ambessa's healing negates a full combo, slot in Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Ambessa.fight: Counterattack right after Ambessa has used her abilities and spent her Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges. Before then, a single ability can close the gap, so do not linger in front of her even at a distance that looks safe. When Ambessa W Repudiation is winding up, stop dealing damage and leave its area.
Ambessa.laning: Poke Ambessa with Ahri Q Orb of Deception while grazing the backline minions to clear the wave. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or gank setup. If mana runs low, stop poking and farm. Keep healing through CS with Ahri P Essence Theft, and do not give up an early kill.
Ambessa.combo: Once Ambessa has finished using her mobility abilities, use Ahri E Charm → Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception. If minions block Charm, cross the wave with Ahri R Spirit Rush to find an angle before using E. Throw Q past Ambessa to land the returning orb too, and keep at least one R dash to get out.
Ambessa.escape: Right after Ambessa has used her abilities and spent her Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges is your chance to close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, immediately use R to dodge the follow-up hit. Do not force an engage while Ahri R Spirit Rush is down; you have no mobility ability then.
Ambessa.phase: Mid game, as core items accumulate, is a strong period for Ambessa. Once Ahri builds ability power, she can also look to catch one target with Ahri E Charm. The given information is insufficient to judge which champion has the advantage late.
Ambessa.teamfight: Do not dive in head-on. Use Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside their range, then pull one target toward your team when you find an angle for Ahri E Charm. Position so neither Ahri nor your team's backline is at the end of the line of Ambessa R Public Execution. Once the fight settles, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire, while counting how many dashes you need to get out.

Azir.watch: If Azir Q Conquering Sands slows you, it is easy to keep taking soldier attacks. Avoid the line where his soldiers stand and move sideways. In narrow passages, Azir R Emperor's Divide pushes away those engaging and leaves a wall, so do not enter there all at once.
Azir.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Azir deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Azir.fight: When a soldier is stationary or after Azir uses Azir Q Conquering Sands, move out of the soldiers' attack line and approach Azir himself. Avoid long trades; land Ahri E Charm and deal your damage in a short burst.
Azir.laning: Use Ahri Q Orb of Deception to poke Azir and hit the backline minions together. Last-hit to keep healing with Ahri P Essence Theft. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or gank setup, and apply pressure when Azir's soldiers disappear or his mana runs low.
Azir.combo: Move to the side or cross the wave with Ahri R Spirit Rush so minions cannot block Ahri E Charm, then use Ahri E Charm → Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Azir and move closer to land the returning orb too.
Azir.escape: Right after forcing out Azir E Shifting Sands is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm, keeping at least one dash to get out.
Azir.phase: In mid game, as you build ability power, land Charm to end fights quickly. Avoid long trades against Azir, who grows stronger as fights drag on.
Azir.teamfight: Poke from outside their range with Ahri Q Orb of Deception, then pull one target toward your team with Ahri E Charm. In open areas, approach from multiple directions so Azir R Emperor's Divide cannot push you all away together. Once the fight settles, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost can detonate mid-flight, so do not just sidestep the aim line slightly; stay outside its range from the start. If it hits you or you are inside a fully formed Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals much more damage. When chilled, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to leave the storm. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your retreat.
Anivia.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Anivia's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Anivia P Rebirth negates a full combo, add Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Anivia.fight: Usually poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception, then look to engage when Anivia Q Flash Frost is down. Anivia has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm. Since breaking through Anivia P Rebirth alone is difficult, pressure her with your jungler or look for a kill while her revive is down.
Anivia.laning: Use Ahri Q Orb of Deception to hit Anivia and the backline minions together. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank. If you are low on mana, stop poking and farm. Keep collecting CS to sustain through Ahri P Essence Theft, and avoid overcommitting when Ahri R Spirit Rush is down.
Anivia.combo: If minions block Ahri E Charm, move to the side for an angle or use Ahri R Spirit Rush to cross the minion wave. Then use Ahri E Charm → Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception so Ahri W Fox-Fire prioritizes the charmed Anivia. Throw the orb past Anivia and hit her on its return, but save at least one dash to get out.
Anivia.escape: When Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm. If Anivia Q Flash Frost hits you, do not keep fighting. Use Ahri R Spirit Rush to leave Anivia R Glacial Storm and break the follow-up with Anivia E Frostbite. Avoid engaging while Ahri R Spirit Rush is down.
Anivia.phase: Later in the game, watch for Anivia W Crystallize's terrain control and fight in open areas instead of narrow paths.
Anivia.teamfight: Avoid narrow jungle and river paths where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your retreat, and start fights in open areas. Rather than diving in from the front, throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside range, then use Ahri E Charm to pull one enemy toward your team when an angle opens. As the fight winds down, use the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire and Ahri R Spirit Rush to chase fleeing enemies, while accounting for a dash to get out.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health and builds Stardust, so stand behind minions and leave its aim line quickly. When low on health, avoid Aurelion Sol E Singularity because it can execute you; if caught, move out immediately. Later in the game, spread out from your teammates to avoid the area knockup from Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Since Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light scales with maximum health, avoid builds that add a lot of health alone.
AurelionSol.fight: Early on, poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception before Aurelion Sol builds up Stardust. When Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm. If Ahri E Charm misses, do not force a continued trade.
AurelionSol.laning: Use Ahri Q Orb of Deception to hit Aurelion Sol and the backline minions together, and save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank. Farm minions to heal through Ahri P Essence Theft, and do not take Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light directly. After learning Ahri R Spirit Rush, push the lane, but roam only when both Ahri E Charm and Ahri R Spirit Rush are ready.
AurelionSol.combo: After Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to cross the minion wave and land Ahri E Charm. Then activate Ahri W Fox-Fire and throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Aurelion Sol. Move toward him to hit with the returning orb, and save a use of Ahri R Spirit Rush to get out.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight goes down is your chance to engage with Ahri R Spirit Rush. If Aurelion Sol E Singularity or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is also down, the risk of being hit by crowd control is lower. Delay the engage if you have no angle to land Ahri E Charm.
AurelionSol.phase: Early on, pressure Aurelion Sol with Ahri Q Orb of Deception while he has little Stardust, and look for openings when Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down. In the mid game, look for Ahri E Charm combos as your ability power grows. Late game, beware of Aurelion Sol's permanently accumulated Stardust.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Spread out from your teammates so Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend cannot hit several of you, and do not cluster in narrow passages. Poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside range, then use Ahri E Charm to pull one enemy toward your team when an angle opens. As the fight winds down, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire, while accounting for the dashes needed to return.

Annie.watch: When the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready and she glows white, stay outside her ability range. After being hit by the area attack from Annie R Summon: Tibbers, do not stay near Tibbers; use Ahri R Spirit Rush to create distance.
Annie.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Annie deals mostly magic damage, so Ahri needs magic resistance. Ahri's magic damage works well against Annie, so there is no need to rush a separate response to her resistances for offense.
Annie.fight: While Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, poke from a distance with Ahri Q Orb of Deception. If Annie has just used her stun, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush, land Ahri E Charm, and attack. Keep at least one cast of Ahri R Spirit Rush to escape after engaging.
Annie.laning: Manage the lane by hitting Annie and the backline minions together with Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Minions block Ahri E Charm, so move to the side for an angle and save it unless you have a kill opportunity or are following up on a gank. Heal through Ahri P Essence Theft by killing minions, and stop poking to farm if you are low on mana.
Annie.combo: After the stun from Annie P Pyromania is down, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to cross the minion wave and land Ahri E Charm. Follow with Ahri W Fox-Fire, then Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Annie, then move toward her to hit with the returning orb.
Annie.escape: Annie having just used the stun from Annie P Pyromania is Ahri's chance to engage. Approach with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm, while accounting for the shield and movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield. Do not force an engage if Annie's stun is ready or Ahri R Spirit Rush is down.
Annie.phase: In the mid game, as your ability power grows, look for chances to catch one enemy with Ahri E Charm. The provided material is insufficient to judge who has the relative advantage late game.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is out of sight or the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, do not let two or three teammates stand together. Poke from a distance with Ahri Q Orb of Deception. If Annie steps forward and uses her stun, catch a target for your team with Ahri E Charm. As the fight winds down, use the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire and Ahri R Spirit Rush to chase fleeing enemies.

Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, its return deals damage again, increasing with your missing health. While marked, move off the straight line between you and Aurora; if you are low on health, retreat before it returns. When Aurora turns invisible with Aurora W Across the Veil, wait for her to reappear instead of rushing Ahri E Charm. Leaving Aurora R Between Worlds slows you, so decide whether to retreat before the area forms.
Aurora.build: Aurora's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Aurora's healing negates a full Ahri combo, add Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Aurora.fight: Avoid trades where you are low on health and waiting for Aurora Q Twofold Hex to return. When Aurora uses a mobility ability to engage and cannot escape with another one, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and look to land Ahri E Charm. Keep at least one cast of Ahri R Spirit Rush to escape after engaging.
Aurora.laning: Poke Aurora with Ahri Q Orb of Deception while also hitting the backline minions to clear the wave. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank, and move to the side for an angle if Aurora is behind minions. Farm CS consistently to heal through Ahri P Essence Theft, and stop poking to farm if you are low on mana. After learning Ahri R Spirit Rush, push the lane, but roam only when both Ahri E Charm and Ahri R Spirit Rush are ready.
Aurora.combo: When Aurora is visible and you have an angle to land Ahri E Charm, use Ahri E Charm → Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception. If minions block Ahri E Charm, cross the wave with Ahri R Spirit Rush to create an angle, then use the same sequence. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Aurora and move toward her to hit with both the outgoing and returning orb.
Aurora.escape: Do not engage immediately just because one of Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, or Aurora R Between Worlds is down. In particular, before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back, look for a window when her other ways to move are also down; then close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm. If you are low on health while marked by Aurora Q Twofold Hex, retreat to avoid its return damage instead of engaging.
Aurora.phase: Early on, farm CS and sustain with Null-Magic Mantle and the healing from Ahri P Essence Theft. In the mid game, as your ability power grows, look for chances to catch one enemy with Ahri E Charm. The provided material is insufficient to judge who has the advantage late game.
Aurora.teamfight: Poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside range, then use Ahri E Charm to pull one enemy toward your team when an angle opens. If Aurora jumps in but fails to catch anyone, look for a chance to catch her with Ahri E Charm. If an ally is caught, the cooldown of Aurora W Across the Veil may reset, so do not leave low-health teammates behind when retreating. As the fight winds down, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire, while accounting for the dashes needed to get out.

Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits, back out of range until the poison wears off, then fight again: Cassiopeia E Twin Fang deals more damage and heals more while you are poisoned. You cannot use Ahri R Spirit Rush inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so go around the cloud. When you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze being cast, turn away to avoid the stun.
Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia deals mostly magic damage, and Ahri has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If the healing from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang negates your combo damage, add Morellonomicon after finishing one core item.
Cassiopeia.fight: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits, keep your distance until the poison wears off. Once you learn Ahri R Spirit Rush, close the gap along a path that avoids Cassiopeia W Miasma, then land Ahri E Charm and fight.
Cassiopeia.laning: Poke Cassiopeia with Ahri Q Orb of Deception while clipping the backline minions to clear the wave. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank, and move to the side so minions do not block it. If you run low on mana, stop poking and farm to use the healing from Ahri P Essence Theft.
Cassiopeia.combo: If minions block Ahri E Charm, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to cross the wave and create an angle, then use Ahri E Charm → Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Landing Ahri E Charm first makes Ahri W Fox-Fire prioritize the charmed Cassiopeia. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Cassiopeia to hit her on both passes.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no dash, so right after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere is your chance to close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush. If Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze is also down, catch her with Ahri E Charm without worrying about the stun. You cannot use Ahri R Spirit Rush to escape an area covered by Cassiopeia W Miasma, so walk out.
Cassiopeia.phase: In mid game, look to catch one target with Ahri E Charm. In late game, choose an angle of entry that keeps Cassiopeia from dealing sustained damage freely.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Do not dive straight in first. Poke from the outside with Ahri Q Orb of Deception and watch where Cassiopeia moves. Right after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere, catch her with Ahri E Charm to give your team a chance to attack together. Once the fight is winding down, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire, but save a dash to get out.

Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage damages targets around the first enemy hit, so do not hide behind minions; move out of range. Reposition to avoid taking consecutive missiles, especially the third. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of standing in front of it.
Corki.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Armor does not block the magic damage from Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki W Valkyrie or the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions.
Corki.fight: Early on, poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception to pressure Corki's farming. Once Corki W Valkyrie is down, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm. Do not stand in front of Corki E Gatling Gun for long; move to the side as you fight.
Corki.laning: Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception so it clips both Corki and the backline minions, poking him while clearing the wave. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank. If Corki stands behind minions, move to the side for an angle. If you are low on mana, stop poking and farm for the healing from Ahri P Essence Theft.
Corki.combo: After Corki W Valkyrie is down, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to cross the minion wave and create an angle for Ahri E Charm. Use Ahri E Charm → Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Corki, then move toward him to land the returning orb too.
Corki.escape: Right after Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie is your opening to engage. Approach with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm, but save at least one dash to get out.
Corki.phase: Corki has low base stats for the first five levels, so pressure his farming with poke and ganks. In mid game, look for Ahri E Charm opportunities as you build ability power. In late game, watch for Corki becoming strong once he has items and can fire missiles from a safe position.
Corki.teamfight: Do not dive straight in first. Poke from outside Corki's range with Ahri Q Orb of Deception. When you have an angle for Ahri E Charm, catch one target toward your team so you can attack together. Once the fight is winding down, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire while planning your way back.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike travels in an arc and applies a mark, so dodge sideways rather than retreating in a straight line. If the mark hits you, create distance because Diana E Lunar Rush may reset. Do not move close right after Diana activates Diana W Pale Cascade; fight once the orbs and shield are gone.
Diana.build: Diana deals mostly magic damage, and Ahri has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Diana.fight: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike sideways while poking with Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Once the shield from Diana W Pale Cascade is gone and Diana E Lunar Rush is also down, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to find an angle and land Ahri E Charm.
Diana.laning: Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank. If you are low on mana, stop poking and farm.
Diana.combo: The basic sequence is Ahri E Charm → Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception. If minions block Ahri E Charm, first use Ahri R Spirit Rush to cross the wave and create an angle. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Diana, then move so the returning orb hits her too.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages with Diana E Lunar Rush without landing Diana Q Crescent Strike first, catch her with Ahri E Charm while her dash is down. You can close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush to land Ahri E Charm, but save at least one dash to get out. If Diana Q Crescent Strike marks you, create distance instead of engaging because Diana E Lunar Rush can reset.
Diana.phase: In mid game, as you build ability power, look to catch one target with Ahri E Charm. In late game teamfights, look for an angle from the outside rather than engaging head-on.
Diana.teamfight: Keep some distance from your teammates so Diana R Moonfall cannot pull in several of you, and use vision to watch for flank angles. Poke from the outside with Ahri Q Orb of Deception, then catch one target near your team with Ahri E Charm when an angle opens. Once the fight is winding down, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire.

Ekko.watch: When you see the warning for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the area to avoid the stun and shield. Step aside from the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder as well. If you see an afterimage behind Ekko, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so do not chase too far even if he is low on health.
Ekko.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ekko deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak negates a full combo, add Morellonomicon after finishing one core item.
Ekko.fight: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, his dash is down, so counter with Ahri E Charm. When you see the warning for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave its area, and commit to the fight after Ekko R Chronobreak is down too. Even when engaging with Ahri R Spirit Rush, save at least one dash to get out.
Ekko.laning: Poke Ekko with Ahri Q Orb of Deception while hitting the backline minions too. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank; if Ekko is behind minions, move to the side for an angle before using it. If you are low on mana, stop poking and farm, securing CS to keep healing with Ahri P Essence Theft.
Ekko.combo: Land Ahri E Charm first so Ahri W Fox-Fire prioritizes the charmed Ekko. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Ekko, then move toward him to land the returning hit too.
Ekko.escape: If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, do not go too deep because he can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak. When both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm.
Ekko.phase: Early on, play safely against Ekko's magic damage while using Ahri Q Orb of Deception to poke and farm. The provided information does not establish who has the advantage in late game, so wait for an angle to land Ahri E Charm in teamfights.
Ekko.teamfight: Instead of diving straight in first, throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside Ekko's range and look for an angle to land Ahri E Charm. If Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, counter with Ahri E Charm, and avoid the marked area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence. Once the fight is winding down, chase with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire, but save a dash to get out.

Fizz.watch: If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark strikes so they are not knocked back too. Ready Ahri E Charm along Fizz’s path when he uses Fizz Q Urchin Strike to follow up, forcing out Fizz E Playful / Trickster.
Fizz.build: Fizz deals mostly magic damage, and Ahri has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Fizz.fight: Right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is used, land Ahri E Charm and trade back with Ahri W Fox-Fire and Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Fizz missing a last hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident is another chance to trade. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, account for that movement tool before engaging.
Fizz.laning: Harass Fizz while clipping the backline minions with Ahri Q Orb of Deception, and save Ahri E Charm for a counterattack or kill opportunity. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Irelia and move toward her to land the returning orb too.

Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame applies an area slow, and the zone left by a projectile empowered by Karma R Mantra explodes again shortly afterward. In the mid game, once you have built ability power, land Ahri E Charm and use your combo to target one enemy. Kassadin.watch: The shield from Kassadin Q Null Sphere absorbs Ahri’s magic poke, so deal damage after Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down. Kassadin E Force Pulse slows, and Kassadin R Riftwalk lets him engage or escape, so keep your distance while Kassadin R Riftwalk is available.

Kassadin can reach the backline, so do not stand apart from your team; watch for a chance to catch him with Ahri E Charm. As the fight winds down, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire, while accounting for the distance you need to get out.

Katarina.watch: If Katarina Q Bouncing Blade hits you, the dagger lands behind Ahri, so step back to avoid standing on it. Stay clear of daggers on the ground to limit Katarina's engage angles. Katarina R Death Lotus deals heavy damage and reduces healing, so interrupt it with Ahri E Charm as soon as it starts.

Stand at an angle to your minions to avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard after it passes through them. Once Ahri E Charm lands, use Ahri W Fox-Fire followed by Ahri Q Orb of Deception to focus all three shots of Ahri W Fox-Fire on Lissandra. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Lissandra and move closer to land the returning orb too.

Check that Lissandra E Glacial Path has been used before engaging, and time your remaining damage for when the damage immunity from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb ends. As the fight winds down, chase fleeing enemies with the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire and Ahri R Spirit Rush.

Leblanc.combo: Land Ahri E Charm first so all three shots of Ahri W Fox-Fire focus LeBlanc. If minions block the path, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to move to the side or beyond the minion wave, then cast Ahri E Charm.

If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, prioritize disengaging and use Ahri R Spirit Rush to leave the chain's range.

Once the fight is winding down, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and use the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire. If a Lux ability hits you, leave her basic attack range so she cannot trigger the mark from Lux P Illumination with a basic attack.

Lux.combo: After dodging Lux Q Light Binding, cross the minion wave with Ahri R Spirit Rush to create an angle for Ahri E Charm. Use Ahri E Charm → Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception so Ahri W Fox-Fire prioritizes the charmed Lux. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Lux, then move toward her to land the returning orb too.

Lux.phase: Early on, before learning Ahri R Spirit Rush, Ahri has no mobility ability. Watch out for Lux Q Light Binding while poking and farming with Ahri Q Orb of Deception. After learning Ahri R Spirit Rush, you can engage when Lux Q Light Binding misses. In mid game, as your ability power builds, you can quickly kill a target hit by Ahri E Charm. Poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside range, then use Ahri E Charm to pull an enemy toward your team when you see an opening. Once the fight settles, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire, but do not overextend.

Mel.watch: Sidestep Mel E Solar Snare to avoid the root at its center. If repeated hits from Mel have built up Overwhelm stacks, back off even if you still appear to have health left. While the stacks remain, Mel R Golden Eclipse can reach you from far away, so wait somewhere safe.
Mel.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Mel's magic damage early. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance first.
Mel.fight: Poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception in lane and save Ahri E Charm until you have a kill opportunity. Bait out Mel W Rebuttal with a basic attack, then close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and look for Ahri E Charm. If Mel E Solar Snare is unavailable, you can engage with less concern about its root.

Mel.escape: When Mel W Rebuttal is unavailable and Mel E Solar Snare has missed, engage with Ahri R Spirit Rush. Save at least one cast of Ahri R Spirit Rush to get out.
Mel.phase: Push and pressure the lane early to slow Mel's growth. In mid game, look for a chance to catch one target with Ahri E Charm. Play to end before late game against Mel, who grows stronger over time.

Instead of diving straight in first, save some uses of Ahri R Spirit Rush for your escape. If you still have Overwhelm stacks after the fight, watch for Mel R Golden Eclipse and wait somewhere safe.

Malzahar.watch: When a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect spreads to a nearby enemy, so do not try to last hit beside that minion. When Malzahar Q Call of the Void appears, move outside the two portals and delay your engage until you avoid the silence. Ahri R Spirit Rush cannot break Malzahar R Nether Grasp, so do not cross an area without vision alone while Malzahar can use his R.

Build magic resistance first against Malzahar Q Call of the Void, Malzahar W Void Swarm, and Malzahar E Malefic Visions. After dodging Malzahar Q Call of the Void, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm while Malzahar W Void Swarm is unavailable. Save at least one cast of Ahri R Spirit Rush to get out.

Back away from a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions and wait for the effect to finish spreading. If Malzahar pushes the lane, set up a chance to engage with your jungler, removing Malzahar P Void Shift first.

Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Malzahar and move toward him to land the returning orb too.
Malzahar.escape: Engage when you have dodged Malzahar Q Call of the Void, Malzahar W Void Swarm is unavailable, and Malzahar P Void Shift has been removed. Malzahar has no mobility ability to create distance, so close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm. If Malzahar can use Malzahar R Nether Grasp, do not engage alone; look for an opportunity with your team.

Use Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside instead of diving in first from the front, then land Ahri E Charm on Malzahar after Malzahar P Void Shift is removed so your team can catch him. Once the fight is decided, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire while keeping enough casts of Ahri R Spirit Rush to get out.

Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once and applies bleed, keep your distance until the bleed ends to avoid the second hit. Naafiri E Eviscerate revives her packmates, so counterattack right after she uses it. Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit dashes to a targeted champion, so do not travel alone while it is ready.

If the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate undoes your full combo, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Naafiri.fight: Stay away while the bleed from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers is active, and counterattack right after she uses Naafiri E Eviscerate. Before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to close the gap and create a chance to land Ahri E Charm. Save at least one Ahri R Spirit Rush dash to escape.

Ahri E Charm hits only the first target, so save it unless you have a kill opportunity or can follow up on a gank. If you use it, move to the side to find an angle. When you run low on mana, stop harassing and farm; keep up your CS to heal with Ahri P Essence Theft.
Naafiri.combo: Land Ahri E Charm first, then use Ahri W Fox-Fire followed by Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Ahri W Fox-Fire prioritizes a charmed champion, so landing Ahri E Charm first matters.
Naafiri.escape: Do not engage just because either Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or Naafiri E Eviscerate is down. Before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back, especially right after she uses Naafiri E Eviscerate, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm. If the bleed from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers is still active, create distance first.
Naafiri.phase: Early on, Ahri can use her range advantage to harass, but do not overextend when Ahri R Spirit Rush is down. Naafiri's roams are most dangerous in the mid game, so maintain broad vision. As Ahri, push the wave and roam when both Ahri E Charm and Ahri R Spirit Rush are ready. In late game front-to-back teamfights, stay grouped so area damage clears Naafiri's packmates.
Naafiri.teamfight: Group with your team so you do not get picked off while spread out. Poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside range, then use Ahri E Charm to pull an enemy toward your team. Retreat immediately after an ally dies, as Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit could let her pick off more of you in succession. Once the fight settles, chase fleeing enemies with the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire and Ahri R Spirit Rush, but account for the dash you will need to get out.

Orianna.watch: Watch where Orianna's ball moves with Orianna Q Command: Attack and position accordingly. Near the ball, Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in; also watch for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance. Early on, avoid taking consecutive basic attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Orianna's magic damage early, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Orianna.fight: Trade right after Orianna Q Command: Attack, while the ball is away from Orianna. If you have an angle to land Ahri E Charm, follow with Ahri W Fox-Fire and Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Account for the shield from Orianna E Command: Protect and keep the trade short.
Orianna.laning: Harass Orianna with Ahri Q Orb of Deception while also hitting the backline minions to clear the wave. Minions block Ahri E Charm, so save it unless you have a kill opportunity or can follow up on a gank. When you run low on mana, focus on farming. Keep up your CS to heal with Ahri P Essence Theft.
Orianna.combo: Land Ahri E Charm first so Ahri W Fox-Fire prioritizes Orianna. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception so it passes through Orianna, then move closer to hit her with the returning orb too.
Orianna.escape: Engage Orianna when the ball is far away or right after she uses Orianna Q Command: Attack. Close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm, but save at least one dash to escape.
Orianna.phase: In the mid game, look for chances to catch someone with Ahri E Charm, and do not overextend while Ahri R Spirit Rush is down.
Orianna.teamfight: Check the ball’s position before Orianna’s, and position yourself to avoid Orianna R Command: Shockwave near the ball. Instead of diving straight in first, use Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside, then use Ahri E Charm to pull an enemy toward your team. Once the fight settles, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting something, so do not stand on top of an ally. If Neeko approaches while disguised, the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom may be hidden; create distance as soon as you suspect her identity. If you see the windup, use the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire or Ahri R Spirit Rush to leave the area.
Neeko.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Neeko's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If being rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then hit by Neeko R Pop Blossom gets you killed, prioritize tenacity.
Neeko.fight: Once Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is also down, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush, land Ahri E Charm, and focus your damage. Do not chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; keep track of the real Neeko.
Neeko.laning: Harass Neeko with Ahri Q Orb of Deception while also hitting the backline minions to clear the wave. Minions block Ahri E Charm, so save it unless you have a kill opportunity or can follow up on a gank. If you are low on mana, stop harassing and farm. Keep up your CS to heal with Ahri P Essence Theft.
Neeko.combo: Land Ahri E Charm first so Ahri W Fox-Fire prioritizes the charmed Neeko. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Neeko and move toward her to hit with the returning orb too.
Neeko.escape: The window while Neeko R Pop Blossom is down is your chance to engage with Ahri R Spirit Rush. Go in when Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is also down, land Ahri E Charm, and save your remaining Ahri R Spirit Rush dashes to escape.
Neeko.phase: In the mid game, fight around landing Ahri E Charm as Ahri builds ability power. In the late game, assess your angle to enter teamfights without assuming either side is stronger.
Neeko.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs cannot root several of you together. If someone whose identity you suspect comes close, spread out early in case of Neeko R Pop Blossom. If you see its windup, escape with Ahri W Fox-Fire or Ahri R Spirit Rush. As Ahri, harass from the outside with Ahri Q Orb of Deception, then pull one enemy toward your team with Ahri E Charm.

Qiyana.watch: If Qiyana approaches with the river element, retreat beyond the root range of Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. If she disappears with the brush element, move into your team's vision. When you are below half health, keep your distance from Qiyana if she has the rock element. Fight in open space: with your back to a wall, or near the river or in a narrow passage, Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can knock you into terrain and stun you.
Qiyana.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Qiyana's main damage is physical and Ahri has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Qiyana.fight: Trade when Qiyana has used both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity and remains in front of you. If only one is down, do not rush in; she can escape with the other mobility ability. Save Ahri E Charm to land during that opening.
Qiyana.laning: Harass Qiyana with Ahri Q Orb of Deception while clipping the backline minions to clear the wave. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or gank follow-up. If you are low on mana, stop harassing and farm. Keep killing minions to heal with Ahri P Essence Theft, and do not overextend when Ahri R Spirit Rush is down.
Qiyana.combo: Before Qiyana E Audacity comes back, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm. Then activate Ahri W Fox-Fire and throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Landing Ahri E Charm first lets you focus all three Ahri W Fox-Fire shots on Qiyana. Save at least one Ahri R Spirit Rush dash to escape.
Qiyana.escape: Engage right after both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are down, especially before Qiyana E Audacity comes back. Avoid the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, approach with Ahri R Spirit Rush in open space, and land Ahri E Charm.
Qiyana.phase: Early on, farm and build armor without giving Qiyana an advantage. Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so be especially careful while Ahri R Spirit Rush is down. Qiyana becomes relatively weaker in the late game, so stay grouped with allies while avoiding angles where Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can hit terrain.
Qiyana.teamfight: Harass with Ahri Q Orb of Deception away from walls, brush, and the river. When you have an angle, pull one enemy toward your team with Ahri E Charm. If Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent knocks you toward terrain, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to move away from it. Once the fight is decided, chase fleeing enemies with the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire and your remaining Ahri R Spirit Rush dashes.

Ryze.watch: When Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, Ryze Q Overload deals increased damage and spreads to nearby targets. If marked, move away from allies and keep your distance until the mark expires. Ryze W Rune Prison roots you if Ryze E Spell Flux has hit you, so dodge E first.
Ryze.build: Ryze deals mostly magic damage, and Ahri has relatively low magic resistance. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Ryze.fight: Harass with Ahri Q Orb of Deception early to slow Ryze's growth before he gets items. Look for an opening when Ryze E Spell Flux has not marked you, land Ahri E Charm, then follow up with damage. Once you learn Ahri R Spirit Rush, you can dash past the minion wave to set up Charm.
Ryze.laning: Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception so it clips both Ryze and the backline minions, harassing while clearing the wave. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank. If you run low on mana, stop harassing and farm. Keep last-hitting to get healing from Ahri P Essence Theft.
Ryze.combo: If minions block your path, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to cross the wave and land Ahri E Charm. Follow with Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception so Fox-Fire prioritizes the charmed Ryze. Throw the orb past Ryze and move toward him to hit him with it on the return.
Ryze.escape: Ryze R Realm Warp being unavailable gives you an opening to engage. If Ryze W Rune Prison is also unavailable, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm. Keep at least one Spirit Rush dash to get out.
Ryze.phase: Ryze lacks mana and damage early, so pressure him with Ahri Q Orb of Deception to slow his growth. In mid game, look for opportunities to land Ahri E Charm as your ability power builds. In late game, keep your distance from allies so Ryze E Spell Flux marks do not spread.
Ryze.teamfight: Harass with Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside Ryze's range, then use Ahri E Charm to pull Ryze toward your team. If you see Ryze R Realm Warp, Ahri E Charm can interrupt Ryze before it activates. Once the fight is decided, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire.

Sylas.watch: The follow-up chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is more dangerous than the first dash. If it hits, you are knocked up and exposed to a follow-up attack, so time Ahri R Spirit Rush to dodge the chain. If Sylas Q Chain Lash clips you, immediately move out of its delayed explosion where the chains cross.
Sylas.build: Sylas deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If healing from Sylas W Kingslayer negates a full combo, add Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Sylas.fight: Engage before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back up. Close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush, land Ahri E Charm, and follow up with damage, keeping at least one dash to escape. Account for healing from Sylas W Kingslayer: do not leave him low and delay the finish too long.
Sylas.laning: Use Ahri Q Orb of Deception to hit both Sylas and the backline minions while harassing. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank. If you run low on mana, stop harassing and farm to get healing from Ahri P Essence Theft.
Sylas.combo: Land Ahri E Charm first so all three shots of Ahri W Fox-Fire focus Sylas. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Sylas and move closer to hit him with the returning orb.
Sylas.escape: Dodge the second chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, then engage before the ability comes back up. Sylas W Kingslayer also closes distance, so check that it is unavailable before using Ahri R Spirit Rush to close the gap and land Ahri E Charm. Keep at least one Spirit Rush dash to disengage.
Sylas.phase: In mid game, Ahri E Charm becomes more powerful as you build ability power. The information provided is insufficient to judge who has the advantage in late game.
Sylas.teamfight: Harass with Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside Sylas's range. Right after Sylas engages with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, land Ahri E Charm and kill him with your team before he can heal. Keep a dash to disengage instead of using Ahri R Spirit Rush to jump in head-on. Once the fight is decided, chase fleeing enemies with the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire and with Ahri R Spirit Rush.

Talon.watch: Taking both hits of Talon W Rake builds stacks of Talon P Blade's End. If the first hit lands, use the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire to leave the return path. Do not chase too far while Talon R Shadow Assault is available; he can escape with its stealth and movement speed.
Talon.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Talon deals physical damage, so build armor first and get health as well to account for flat penetration. Talon has relatively high magic resistance, so add penetration and make use of the true damage from the returning Ahri Q Orb of Deception.
Talon.fight: Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is your chance to close the gap and counterattack. Land Ahri E Charm, then follow up with Ahri W Fox-Fire and Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Counterattack more aggressively if you have confirmed that Talon R Shadow Assault has already been used.
Talon.laning: Aim Ahri Q Orb of Deception at both Talon and the backline minions, but save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank. Share Talon's position in case he roams, and keep vision along jungle routes.
Talon.combo: Land Ahri E Charm first so Ahri W Fox-Fire prioritizes the charmed Talon. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Talon, then move toward him to land the returning true damage.
Talon.escape: Right after drawing out Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and look to land Ahri E Charm. If Talon W Rake hits you, leave its return path first; chase only after confirming Talon R Shadow Assault is unavailable. Keep at least one Ahri R Spirit Rush dash to escape when you engage.
Talon.phase: Talon is stronger in early trades, so farm safely and survive. In mid game, use Ahri E Charm to create opportunities as your ability power builds. In late game, group up to fight Talon as his impact falls off.
Talon.teamfight: Harass with Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside Talon's range. If Talon dives your backline, lock him down with Ahri E Charm and respond with your team. Do not chase too deep while Talon R Shadow Assault is available. Once the fight is decided, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire, while accounting for the dashes you need to get out.

Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere lies between Syndra and Ahri, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can push it into you and stun you, so move off the sphere's line. Syndra W Force of Will slows and deals true damage. When your health is low, beware the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Syndra's mostly magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for movement speed to dodge Syndra's skillshots. Keep track of your total health given the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.fight: Right after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used, Ahri has an opening to close the gap. If it is still available or you are standing in line with a sphere, reposition first.
Syndra.laning: Harass Syndra with Ahri Q Orb of Deception while hitting the backline minions to clear the wave. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank; move to the side to line it up on Syndra behind minions. If you run low on mana, stop harassing and last-hit to keep getting healing from Ahri P Essence Theft.
Syndra.combo: When Syndra E Scatter the Weak is unavailable, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to cross the minion wave and line up Ahri E Charm. Use Ahri E Charm → Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Syndra, then move toward her to land the returning orb. Keep at least one Ahri R Spirit Rush dash to escape.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak has a long cooldown and is Syndra's only self-defense tool, so engage with Ahri R Spirit Rush right after she uses it. Syndra has no dash, making it key to close the gap and land Ahri E Charm.
Syndra.phase: Early on, Ahri has no mobility without Ahri R Spirit Rush, so play safely, dodge Syndra’s abilities, and farm. In mid game, once Ahri has built ability power, look to catch one enemy with Ahri E Charm. In late teamfights, poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception and look for an opening instead of engaging head-on.
Syndra.teamfight: Move the fight away from areas with several Syndra Q Dark Spheres, where Syndra R Unleashed Power is dangerous. Harass with Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside Syndra's range, then use Ahri E Charm to pull one enemy toward your team. Once the fight is decided, chase with Ahri R Spirit Rush and use the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire.

Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge. If trapped inside, do not run into the edge; move around inside until it disappears, or use Ahri R Spirit Rush to get out. The landing area of Veigar W Dark Matter appears in advance, so sidestep it. If you are below half health, move out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst.
Veigar.build: Veigar deals mainly magic damage, and Ahri has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Veigar.fight: Poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception from the early game, but keep moving so you can dodge Veigar W Dark Matter. Once Veigar E Event Horizon is down, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm from an angle clear of minions.
Veigar.laning: Aim Ahri Q Orb of Deception at both Veigar and the backline minions, but stand behind minions to avoid Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up a gank. If you are low on mana, stop poking and farm.
Veigar.combo: After Veigar E Event Horizon is down, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to cross the minion wave and line up Ahri E Charm. Use Ahri E Charm → Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Throw the orb past Veigar, then move closer so the returning orb hits too. Save at least one use of Ahri R Spirit Rush to get out.
Veigar.escape: Right after Veigar uses Veigar E Event Horizon is Ahri's chance to engage. Veigar has no ability to create distance on his own, so approach with Ahri R Spirit Rush and look for Ahri E Charm. Do not force an engage while Veigar E Event Horizon is available.
Veigar.phase: Early game is when Ahri can pressure Veigar before he has built stacks. As the game goes on, the permanent growth from Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power makes the matchup harder. Before late-game objective fights, check Veigar's position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon.
Veigar.teamfight: Poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside range while watching for Veigar E Event Horizon. When you have an opening, use Ahri E Charm to pull an enemy toward your team. If trapped in Veigar E Event Horizon, move around inside instead of running into its edge. As the fight winds down, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire, while accounting for a dash to get out.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stay out of his basic attack range or you will be stunned. Stay behind minions to reduce damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
TwistedFate.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Twisted Fate deals mainly magic damage, and Ahri has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
TwistedFate.fight: In lane, use Ahri Q Orb of Deception to hit both minions and Twisted Fate. Once he has used the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, or Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and look for Ahri E Charm.
TwistedFate.laning: Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception so it grazes the enemy backline minions, clearing the wave and poking at the same time. Minions block Ahri E Charm, so save it unless you have a kill opportunity or are following up a gank. If you run out of mana, focus on farming. If you suspect a roam with Twisted Fate R Destiny, alert your team immediately.
TwistedFate.combo: If Ahri E Charm lands first, Ahri W Fox-Fire prioritizes the charmed Twisted Fate. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past him and move toward him so the returning orb hits too.
TwistedFate.escape: Right after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is your chance to engage. Save at least one use of Ahri R Spirit Rush to get out.
TwistedFate.phase: Do not overextend early while Ahri R Spirit Rush is unavailable, and use minion kills to get healing from Ahri P Essence Theft. In mid game, as your ability power grows, look to catch one enemy with Ahri E Charm. In late teamfights, create openings with Ahri Q Orb of Deception poke and Ahri E Charm instead of engaging head-on.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside range, then use Ahri E Charm to pull an enemy toward your team. Once Twisted Fate has used the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, look for a chance to close in with Ahri R Spirit Rush.

Vex.watch: If the Doom indicator from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is active, delay Ahri R Spirit Rush. The area of Vex E Looming Darkness grows at longer range, so dodge it with a short sidestep when within range. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you, move toward your team so they can help absorb the follow-up dash.
Vex.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance against Vex's main damage.
Vex.fight: Fight after Vex uses the Doom from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom on the wave or for poke and Vex W Personal Space is also down. Land Ahri E Charm to lock down Vex, then deal damage with Ahri W Fox-Fire and Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Even when engaging with Ahri R Spirit Rush, save a dash to get out.
Vex.laning: Poke Vex with Ahri Q Orb of Deception while hitting the backline minions too. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up a gank, and do not throw it at Vex when she is behind minions. Keep farming to use the healing from Ahri P Essence Theft, and stop poking if you are low on mana.
Vex.combo: If minions are in the way, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to cross the wave and line up Ahri E Charm. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Vex, then move toward her so the returning orb hits too.
Vex.escape: Right after Vex uses the Doom from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is your window to engage with Ahri R Spirit Rush. While Vex R Shadow Surge is down, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and look for Ahri E Charm. If dashing applies a Gloom mark to you, move out of Vex's basic attack range and wait for the mark to disappear.
Vex.phase: Early on, Ahri has no mobility while Ahri R Spirit Rush is unavailable, so do not overextend. The provided information is insufficient to judge which champion has the advantage late game.
Vex.teamfight: Poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception from outside range, then use Ahri E Charm to pull Vex toward your team. If an ally is marked by Vex R Shadow Surge, they should move toward the team so everyone can absorb Vex's dash together. Low-health allies should first move out of Vex's range to prevent Vex R Shadow Surge from resetting after a kill.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so avoid standing in line with the minion wave and sidestep it. Staying in Viktor W Gravity Field stuns you, so leave its area as soon as it appears and do not keep trading inside it.
Viktor.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Viktor deals mainly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. In Viktor W Gravity Field, use your movement speed to walk out instead of waiting to be stunned.
Viktor.fight: Poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception early, before Viktor P Glorious Evolution builds up. After dodging Viktor W Gravity Field, if you have an opening, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm.
Viktor.laning: Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception so it grazes the enemy backline minions, farming and poking at the same time. Avoid standing in line with the wave so you can dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray, and save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up a gank. Use the healing from Ahri P Essence Theft triggered by minion kills. If you are low on mana, stop poking and farm.
Viktor.combo: If minions are blocking Ahri E Charm, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to cross the wave and line it up, then use Ahri E Charm → Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Land Ahri E Charm first so all three shots of Ahri W Fox-Fire target Viktor. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Viktor and move toward him so the returning orb hits too.
Viktor.escape: Viktor has no dash to escape on his own. If he places Viktor W Gravity Field, leave its area first to avoid the stun. Then close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and look for Ahri E Charm. Save at least one remaining use of Ahri R Spirit Rush to disengage.
Viktor.phase: Viktor is weakest early, before Viktor P Glorious Evolution builds up, so keep him under pressure with poke. In mid game, look for an opportunity to catch one enemy with Ahri E Charm. Be more careful of Viktor as the game goes late, since his accumulated growth is permanent.
Viktor.teamfight: Do not engage head-on first. Poke from the outside with Ahri Q Orb of Deception and look for an angle to pull Viktor toward your team with Ahri E Charm. Do not keep fighting inside Viktor W Gravity Field. As the fight winds down, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire.

Vladimir.watch: Vladimir W Sanguine Pool destroys incoming projectiles, so do not throw out Ahri E Charm carelessly while he can use it. When Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, put minions between you and him or move out of range. Vladimir R Hemoplague increases the damage you take, so back off until it ends.
Vladimir.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vladimir's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If his healing erases the damage from a full combo, finish one core item, then add Morellonomicon.
Vladimir.fight: Once Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm to fight him. Keep at least one use of Ahri R Spirit Rush to escape when you go in.
Vladimir.laning: Hit Vladimir and the backline minions together with Ahri Q Orb of Deception to clear the wave. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank, and stop harassing to farm when you run low on mana. After learning Ahri R Spirit Rush, push the lane, but roam only when both Ahri E Charm and Ahri R Spirit Rush are ready.
Vladimir.combo: First draw out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool with Ahri Q Orb of Deception or another ability, then land Ahri E Charm when the pool ends. If minions block your Charm, move to the side or cross the minion line with Ahri R Spirit Rush to find an angle. After landing Charm, use Ahri W Fox-Fire, then Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Move toward Vladimir after throwing the orb so the returning orb hits too.
Vladimir.escape: The moment Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends is your chance to catch him with Ahri E Charm. Vladimir moves more slowly while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, so you can also close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush. If you are affected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, back off first and go in after it ends.
Vladimir.phase: In the mid game, Ahri E Charm becomes more potent as Ahri builds ability power. If you give Vladimir time, he gains both health and ability power, making him harder to face.
Vladimir.teamfight: Harass from outside his range with Ahri Q Orb of Deception, then use an opening for Ahri E Charm to pull one enemy toward your team. Do not group with allies inside Vladimir R Hemoplague's area, and back off until it ends if you are affected. Once the fight settles, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire, while keeping a dash available to escape.

Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so change direction and sidestep when you see him charging it. Be especially careful of Xerath E Shocking Orb: if it stuns you, his follow-up attacks are easier to land. When you see Xerath cast Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge immediately or, if you can reach him safely, engage while he cannot move.
Xerath.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath deals mostly magic damage and Ahri has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.fight: Early on, harass with Ahri Q Orb of Deception and save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank. Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush to fight. Keep at least one use of Ahri R Spirit Rush to get back out when you go in.
Xerath.laning: Aim Ahri Q Orb of Deception at Xerath and the backline minions together to harass while clearing the wave. Avoid Xerath's heavy damage and collect CS to keep healing with Ahri P Essence Theft. After Xerath has spent a lot of mana, push the lane and call your jungler; if Ahri runs low on mana, stop harassing and farm.
Xerath.combo: Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, cross the minion line with Ahri R Spirit Rush to find an angle for Ahri E Charm. After landing Ahri E Charm, use Ahri W Fox-Fire, then Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Xerath and move toward him to hit with the returning orb too.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no dash, so the moment Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your opening to engage. Close in with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm, but save a dash to get out.

Xerath cannot move during Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, so look for a chance to engage while dodging it. Once the fight settles, chase with the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire and with Ahri R Spirit Rush, while judging how far you can go without overcommitting.

Zed.watch: Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move outside the shadow's Zed E Shadow Slash range to avoid the slow. If Zed R Death Mark is applied to you, interrupt his combo with Ahri E Charm so he cannot add more damage.
Zed.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Zed's main damage is physical and Ahri has low armor, so build armor first.
Zed.fight: Look for an opening after Zed W Living Shadow disappears or after Zed has already swapped positions with his shadow. If Zed R Death Mark is also down, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush, land Ahri E Charm, and deal damage.
Zed.laning: Harass Zed with Ahri Q Orb of Deception while hitting the backline minions too. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank, and get healing from Ahri P Essence Theft by killing minions. Farm without overcommitting when you are low on mana or Ahri R Spirit Rush is unavailable.
Zed.combo: Cross the minion line with Ahri R Spirit Rush to find an angle for Ahri E Charm. Land Ahri E Charm first, then use Ahri W Fox-Fire followed by Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Throw Ahri Q Orb of Deception past Zed and move toward him to hit with the returning orb too.
Zed.escape: Do not engage just because Zed W Living Shadow is down; also check whether Zed R Death Mark is still unavailable. While both movement options are down, approach with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm. Save at least one use of Ahri R Spirit Rush to escape.
Zed.phase: Early on, use Cloth Armor to survive one of Zed's combos without giving him an advantage. Late game, stay grouped with your team to give Zed fewer isolated targets.
Zed.teamfight: Use Ahri Q Orb of Deception from the outside rather than engaging head-on first, then use Ahri E Charm to pull Zed or another enemy toward your team. If Zed enters with Zed R Death Mark, interrupt his combo with Ahri E Charm while the mark is on you. Once the fight settles, chase fleeing enemies with Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire.

If he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, create distance early when low on health, since his return can deal additional damage. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path and moves him behind the last champion hit, so do not stand alone at the very back of your team in a teamfight.

Yone.laning: Keep your distance when Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, as he may be preparing a whirlwind. Use Ahri E Charm to counter his engage or when you have a clear opportunity. If you are low on mana, stop poking and farm.

Yone.escape: If Yone engages first with Yone E Soul Unbound, look for a chance to stop his return with Ahri E Charm. Before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up, close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and look for Charm. If only Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone E Soul Unbound is down, account for his remaining mobility before going in.

Ahri should poke from the outside with Ahri Q Orb of Deception, then catch Yone with Ahri E Charm when he engages to give her team a chance to attack. As the fight winds down, chase with the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire and Ahri R Spirit Rush, but save a dash to get out.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you will fall asleep shortly afterward. Move behind a wall or an ally before then to get out of the angle and range of Zoe Q Paddle Star! A missed bubble also remains as a trap, so be careful around narrow paths without vision and brush entrances. When Zoe throws Zoe Q Paddle Star! and is about to redirect it, interrupt her with Ahri E Charm.
Zoe.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zoe deals mostly magic damage, and Ahri has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. However, resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, so prioritize dodging the bubble.
Zoe.fight: Poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception, then go in immediately after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is used. Use Ahri R Spirit Rush to close the gap or cross the minion wave to create an angle for Ahri E Charm, and save one dash to get out. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, aim for the spot where she will return.
Zoe.laning: Poke Zoe with Ahri Q Orb of Deception while also hitting the backline minions, and secure CS to heal with Ahri P Essence Theft. Minions block Ahri E Charm, so save it unless you have a kill opportunity or are following up on a gank. If you are low on mana, stop poking and farm. After learning Ahri R Spirit Rush, push the wave, but roam only when both Ahri E Charm and Ahri R Spirit Rush are ready.
Zoe.combo: From an angle clear of minions, use Ahri E Charm → Ahri W Fox-Fire → Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Landing Charm first lets all three Fox-Fire shots focus Zoe. Throw Orb of Deception past Zoe and move toward her to hit with the returning orb too.
Zoe.escape: Immediately after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is used, look for a chance to go in with Ahri R Spirit Rush. While Zoe R Portal Jump is down, close the gap and look for Ahri E Charm. When engaging, save at least one Spirit Rush dash to get out.
Zoe.phase: Early on, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and focus on poking with Ahri Q Orb of Deception and farming. In the mid game, as you build ability power, you can quickly take down a target hit by Ahri E Charm. In late game teamfights, poke from the outside and look for a Charm angle.
Zoe.teamfight: Instead of diving in first from the front, poke from outside Zoe's range with Ahri Q Orb of Deception and use Ahri E Charm to pull Zoe toward your team. When Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, look for a chance to close in with Ahri R Spirit Rush. As the fight winds down, chase with the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire and Ahri R Spirit Rush, while accounting for the dash you need to get out.

Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him dash through minions to reach Ahri, so keep your distance within the wave. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, go around it or save your key abilities until it disappears.

Manage the wave so a small enemy wave pushes toward Ahri, leaving fewer minions for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to dash through. Save Ahri E Charm for a kill opportunity or to follow up on a gank, and focus on farming if you run low on mana.
Yasuo.combo: If Ahri E Charm lands first, all three shots of Ahri W Fox-Fire will prioritize the charmed Yasuo. If minions block Ahri E Charm, use Ahri R Spirit Rush to cross the line and find an angle before starting your combo.
Yasuo.escape: Engage just after Yasuo throws the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or before Yasuo R Last Breath is ready again, when you can chain crowd control. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade has a short cooldown, so do not engage just because he used it. Close the gap with Ahri R Spirit Rush and land Ahri E Charm.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, poke with Ahri Q Orb of Deception, but manage the wave and play patiently because Yasuo can dash through minions to reach you. The provided information is not enough to determine who has the advantage late. Do not force plays while Ahri R Spirit Rush is unavailable.
